Trigger You cast a Vow.

Cost 1 additional Conviction

The Vow is Reinforced. A Vow that grants a bonus or penalty grants 1 more; a Vow that grants resistance grants 5 more; a Vow that redirects damage redirects it to a maximum of twice your level; a Vow with none of those lasts twice as long. This is the same one-degree improvement Stage IV of the Trial grants all your Vows, and a Vow gains it only once — Reinforcing a Vow at Stage IV does nothing.
